# Commission Account Payouts Clause

Prepares independent MyOS account-to-account Payment Instructions for commission payouts. Collection defaults to `/payouts`, commission to `/commission`; parameters require external bootstrap provision by seller with guarantor as the declared supplied party. The configured operator must be `test` or `stripe` with a nonempty operator account. Provision refuses a different guarantor.

`preparePayout` accepts `key`, `amountMinor` and account context. Gross commission must be an integer from 1 through 100,000,000. Account context requires payer/payee bindings, platform account and `TEST` or `LIVE` environment. New preparations are limited to 20 process entries and refused while commission is reserved.

The prepared instruction freezes gross commission, fee and net partner transfer, agreement origin, currency, operator and seller/partner account routing. Gross reservation is distinct from net instruction amount and fee. The seller bootstraps and provides the instruction; the operator executes only after the Agreement links it. Pre-link native cancellation releases the gross reservation once. An opening event is emitted only for a new accepted preparation, never as proof of settlement.

Configuration references: `bindings.collection` defaults to `/payouts`; `bindings.commission` defaults to `/commission`; `bindings.parties` is configured by the caller/type context; `bindings.sources` is configured by the caller/type context; `bindings.template` is configured by the caller/type context; `parameters.allowedFields` declares `[]`; `parameters.fieldPaths` declares `{"amountMinor":"/paymentTerms/amountMinor","limitMinor":"/paymentTerms/limitMinor","payoutTerms":"/paymentDetails/payoutTerms"}`; `parameters.obtain` declares `"provide"`; `parameters.prepareFor` declares `"bootstrap"`; `parameters.suppliedBy` declares `"seller"`; `parameters.suppliedParties` declares `["guarantor"]`.
